finding.sequence_description: Cross-provider JWT audience confusion: same trusted JWKS source used by two OAuth sources; present a JWT minted for provider-A (aud=clientA) to provider-B (clientB) and ensure it is rejected (audience binding).
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_control_clientA_login_status < 400 AND user_attack_clientB_with_audA_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_control_clientA_login_status=200 < 400 → True) AND (user_attack_clientB_with_audA_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: Provider B accepted a JWT whose aud was intended for provider A (cross-client audience confusion), enabling permissions beyond UpstreamIntent for clientB.

Assertion FAILED: numeric_control_login_http_status < 400 AND numeric_attack_login_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: (numeric_control_login_http_status=200 < 400 → True) AND (numeric_attack_login_http_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: Float-valued numeric claim (department_id=100.7) was accepted where policy intent requires exact integer match (department_id==100), indicating type coercion that can expand authorization.
